description: Teresa Lin announced today that she is withdrawing from the race for Georgia House District 49 due to a health issue that needs her full attention, and is endorsing Sara Fuchs to run in her place.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Sara Fuchs for Georgia
title: Teresa Lin withdraws from House District 49 race, Sara Fuchs to carry the campaign forward. — Sara Fuchs is the Democratic candidate for Georgia State House District 49, representing parts of Alpharetta, Roswell and Milton, in the November 3, 2026 election.
